Sample finding: Kettle is the sample product, so this item, its commit and its readings are simulated.

proposals.title: Memoise the heatmap's week buckets

## Summary
Switching a week rebuilds every bucket of the year. Keep the buckets per week and rebuild only the one shown.

## Description
Sample finding: Kettle is the sample product, so this item, its commit and its readings are simulated.
